text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: GPU queue length for model redwood-beta in us-east-1 exceeded 5,000. Throttling engaged, many requests 429-ing. Pager routed to @lee (oncall).
lee: ack — I'm on it. joining bridge and digging into metrics.
maria: seeing weird oscillation in autoscaler: frequent scale_down spikes. gpu_util avg ~30% but queue_len 5.2k, scale events every ~90s. logs attached from autoscaler: `scale_event: {from:8,to:3,reason:stabilization_window}`
raj: pulling autoscaler logs now — looks like cooldown/stabilizationPolicy is too aggressive for our burst pattern. max_scale_down_rate is 0.6 and window 30s. that will thrash with noisy queue.
emily: manual mitigation — I'm going to scale the red-pool to 12 GPUs to buy time. running: ```kubectl -n inference scale deploy/red-pool --replicas=12```
chris: also rolling a routing change to divert low-priority/async jobs to spillover-cpu pool to reduce GPU pressure. will apply a temporary route rule.
bridge-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.internal/bridge/5032109999 (auto-joined)
sara: CS update: multiple customers reporting 20-40s gen latency and some 429s. ticket #7892 is getting noisy. need ETA for mitigation.
maria: I can relax autoscaler scale down aggressiveness now: bumping stabilization window to 120s and max_scale_down_rate to 0.2. patch: ```autoscaler:
  stabilizationWindowSeconds: 120
  maxScaleDownRate: 0.2
  maxSurge: 3
```
raj: confirmed manual scale completed and routing change applied — queue length dropped ~40% in 6m. noticing token-bucket throttle still tight for new requests; bumping refill rate for bucket to allow steady ingress.
chris: routing rule active: `route: if priority==low -> spillover-cpu` — verified ~12% of incoming traffic diverted. low-priority backlog now on CPU nodes.
emily: monitoring runtime logs — no OOMs or model crashes. backlog was pure capacity + autoscaler thrash. keeping manual scale for 20m and watching.
lee: quick timeline summary for the bridge: initial surge triggered autoscaler thrash (scale up -> immediate scale down) due to short stabilization window + bursty ingest. that produced long queue growth and token-bucket throttles, causing customer-visible latency and some 429s.
maria: creating a short-lived metric to detect oscillation (peak/trough rate > 2x within 3 windows) — will wire an alert. also opening PR for a permanent autoscaler policy change.
raj: applied temp fix to token-bucket: `refill_rate` +50% and increased bucket size. that removed the immediate 429s for new requests.
sara: drafting a brief customer status: "We experienced increased latency due to autoscaling instability; mitigation in progress, routing low-priority jobs away, no model data loss." will post after 10m of stability.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity currently P2 (partial customer impact). request owners to mark if escalates.
chris: major mitigation checklist: manual scale to 12, routing diversion, token-bucket tweak, autoscaler stabilization patch. recommending we keep manual scale until autoscaler behavior is validated for 30m.
emily: agree. we'll start gradual scale-down only if queue < 500 and 15m of stable metrics.
lee: assigning follow-ups: raj -> autoscaler code/config fix + test; maria -> runbook + alert for oscillation; chris -> routing guard to auto-enable when queue > threshold; sara -> customer comms + postmortem draft. I'll own incident writeup.
maria: opened PR https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/1245 (autoscaler policy + docs).
raj: will create a unit/integration test that simulates bursty ingest to ensure stabilization window prevents thrash. linking ticket shortly.
sara: posted interim status to affected customers. CS will update on new info.
lee: looks stable for now — queue trending down, throttles reduced. planning to scale to target 6 in 10m if stable.
raj: setting target now: ```kubectl -n inference patch hpa/red-pool -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 3, "maxReplicas": 12}}'```
chris: note for postmortem: strange nightly ingest spike + insufficient per-customer rate limits. suggest per-customer backpressure + priority QoS.
emily: closing bridge in 30m unless regression. will add monitoring dashboards for queue-to-gpu ratio.
lee: final: incident declared RESOLVED at 5032112800 (sustained stability, queue drained, throttles gone). postmortem and action items assigned. thanks all. :thumbsup:
